quote: We prompt GPT-4 and the instruction-tuned variant of Llama 3 8B with the same instructions and codebook given to human annotators (Appendix C).
We recruited N = 2,624 participants on Prolific to read and rate empathy towards personal stories.
guideline: Participants rated their empathy towards the story, checked which narrative elements contributed to their emotional reaction, and answered questions about narrative-reader interaction effects and reader characteristics.
